fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-08-02 states that the complainant was allegedly pushed and struck during a street argument at Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area, on 2025-08-02 at roughly 18:45. Contact details given by the complainant, Lakshmi Krishnan, include the number 9000000075. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Senthil Krishnan, using the number 9000000461. Gopal Muthu (9000000403), described as a driver, was also mentioned in the complaint. A witness, Buvaneswari Sri, reachable on 9000000294, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Minor dispute reportedly turned into a scuffle in a public place.
fields.Keywords: altercation, street dispute, CCTV, suspect, witness, evening, bus stand, mobile number
